bugs.summary: lru_cache returns the same list object on every call, and engine.price_quote extends that list in place (`rules += active_promos(now)`), so promotions accumulate in the cached rules: each quote during a promotion adds another copy, and they stay after it ends.
bugs.trigger: Two Black Friday quotes for acme on a $100 cart: the first discounts 1450 cents, the second 2305 (black-friday applied twice); a July quote afterwards still applies both copies.

related_valid: The cache is only invalidated by save_rules in this process; rules changed by another process or worker, or directly in the database, stay stale until restart.
Callers of load_rules (e.g. list_rules_handler) now share one mutable list, so any caller that mutates it corrupts every later read.
